dct_title_s: Pas caarte van de bocht van Gabon Iusſchen C. Formoſa en C. de Lopo Gonſalves
dct_description_sm: Includes title on a piece of masonry, on each side are natives and apes. "The scale is illustrated on another rectangular stone block with the head and shoulders of a male and female leaning on the masonry." A ship, sea monster and a compass rose with numerous rhumb lines decorate the seas. Lower right: 6.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0268, p. 305
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0268.
